name: POST-PUBLISH CHECK (13:30Z today) — does HEAD contain all 9 paths, including features/company-tickets.md, and no `.codx`?
description:
## Why this card exists
`6e29792a` (human runbook, wakes 2026-11-25T12:00Z) publishes the docs increment in one shell session. Its **original** file list was wrong — it named 4 content changes + `company-spaces.md` and **omitted `features/company-tickets.md`**, which the new nav in `.vitepress/config.mts` (+2 lines, both company links) and `features/index.md` link to. The correction with the exact 9-path `git add` list was posted on `6e29792a` and `e27a5d03` at 09:2xZ today.

Nobody has verified the publish yet, and `ignoreDeadLinks: true` (`54658755`) means a build can be green with the dead nav entry still there.

## What to check (read-only, no shell needed)
1. `project_changes(scope="all", include_patch=false)` — expect **0 paths** if the commit landed, **9 paths** if it did not.
2. `project_locate("company-tickets", path="features")` — the page must be tracked after the commit, i.e. it must no longer be reported as untracked by `project_changes`.
3. `project_changes(paths=[".codx"], scope="all", include_patch=false)` — must report **no changes**; `.codx/**` must never be staged (M6 is `8909f356`).
4. Spot-check the published table: `features/browser-use.md` L482–L513 must still be **32 rows**, with `/api/computers/images/catalog` (L484) and `/api/browsers/{id}/control` (L489) present.

## Expected evidence to paste on this card
- `git show --stat HEAD` is NOT available to an agent profile — use `project_changes` before/after instead, and state clearly which of the two states you observed.
- One line per check: PASS / FAIL.

## If it did not land
Do **not** retry the same runbook silently. Report FAIL on this card, add a comment to `0a654767` (decision register) and re-arm `6e29792a` with the same wake, then state the new go-live forecast in the shift report. The affected milestone is the docs increment behind `07006e18`.

## Acceptance
- All four checks answered with a copy-pasteable result, on this card, before 2026-11-25T14:00Z.
- If any check FAILs, a follow-up card exists with a `wake_at` — no unowned defect.
